name: @danypops/packed
description: Host-neutral contracts and persistence primitives for agent package composition

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/public/agent-tools.ts src/public/atomic-json.ts src/public/repository-policy.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --minify && bun build src/cli/repository-policy-cli.ts --outfile dist/repository-policy-cli.js --target node --format esm --minify && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.public.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test test
